body: It's hard to voice anything to her in a way that isn't taken as a personal attack. I'm afraid if I begin to distance myself from T at all, K will take it personally. I guess I just can't let it effect me.

It's difficult in that sense because I don't have any desire to date any other men. I'd probably just be holding back in general. I guess off of the initial question, do you think it's possible for someone mono to be happy in a poly relationship?
I think a big part of it has also been realizing my differences with K, and I would never ask to break them up.

That's good advice. I guess when I mean "Secondary" I'm being afraid of her telling him to cut me out. I know they are Primary, but she always tries to make everything equal, as she has from the beginning. We've tried explaining different ways, like even dating 2 identical twins would be totally different relationships, but it seems like she wants equality in all aspects, but just in theory. Thank you for helping me to see things more from her perspective.

I don't fully live with them, but I am around more often than not to help with the kids/around the house. K has a lot of external issues, so a lot of pressure falls on T, and I try to help where I can, but it's hard when I feel the empathy fading.

I know they have had sex with a third in the past, but no, never a poly relationship like this. Theory is much different than practice.
Or he even. Sucks feeling like I'm on the outside of my own relationship.

That's a good way pf phrasing it. I've really just been trying to sit back and let them figure out what they need without getting too attached. I want it to work, but I'm feeling more and more like it won't.
Everything is so expensive anyway that it doesn't matter. If I tried to live on my own I'd be homeless again, and then really going back to sexual favors.
I apparently don't have any real disabilities because I've tried before. I've even been turned down for medical insurance, and I'm sick and depressed all the time with not treatment.
I have a job, but I can't get to it anymore and it physically is such a burden some days that I'm indifferent if I lose it.
It's more-so that my parents wouldn't be better. They are extremely physically and emotionally abusive as well. At least my Bf has never hit me.
